I long for documentaries that take a more nuanced approach, offering genuine insights into the artists and genres they profile. This recent viewing made me feel as if I was being fed a diluted version of something that deserved much more attention and care. It’s disheartening because music documentaries can inspire and educate, yet this one left me feeling empty and uninterested.

Finding a good documentary can sometimes feel like searching for a diamond in a sea of stones, especially when the trend seems to lean towards sensationalism rather than substance. Engaging with others who share your interests can sometimes lead to discovering hidden gems that aren't mainstream but are infinitely more rewarding.
